purpose: Descriptive deterministic contiguous-window UTMOSv2 proxy coverage; not a validated whole-file MOS or speech-quality acceptance gate.

windowing.start_rule: starts 0, 72000, 144000, ... until source frames are covered
windowing.remainder_rule: include the final shorter remainder as its own window; native UTMOSv2 tiles short in-memory audio to its 3 s SSL duration
windowing.coverage_invariant: first start=0; each next start equals previous end; final end=source_frames; no gaps or overlap
windowing.timeline: contiguous source-frame windows; no random timeline crop

native_prediction.call: model.predict(data=window, sr=24000, predict_dataset='sarulab', device='cpu', num_workers=0, batch_size=1, num_repetitions=1, remove_silent_section=True, verbose=False)
native_prediction.verified_signature: (*, data: torch.Tensor | np.ndarray | None = None, sr: int = 16000, input_path: Path | str | None = None, input_dir: Path | str | None = None, val_list: list[str] | None = None, val_list_path: Path | str | None = None, predict_dataset: str = 'sarulab', device: str | torch.device = 'cuda:0', num_workers: int = 0, batch_size: int = 16, num_repetitions: int = 1, remove_silent_section: bool = True, verbose: bool = True)
native_prediction.silence_handling: remove_silent_section=True, matching the prior language-quality MOS run
native_prediction.window_seed_handling: random.seed/numpy.random.seed/torch.manual_seed set to 42 before every window call
native_prediction.aggregation: duration-weighted mean by source window duration, descriptive custom aggregation only; not validated whole-file MOS

stdout_capture.hash_scope: all process stdout emitted before receipt finalization

utmosv2.api_signature: (*, data: torch.Tensor | np.ndarray | None = None, sr: int = 16000, input_path: Path | str | None = None, input_dir: Path | str | None = None, val_list: list[str] | None = None, val_list_path: Path | str | None = None, predict_dataset: str = 'sarulab', device: str | torch.device = 'cuda:0', num_workers: int = 0, batch_size: int = 16, num_repetitions: int = 1, remove_silent_section: bool = True, verbose: bool = True)
utmosv2.api_call: model.predict(data=window, sr=24000, predict_dataset='sarulab', device='cpu', num_workers=0, batch_size=1, num_repetitions=1, remove_silent_section=True, verbose=False)

limitations: The contiguous timeline windows provide coverage, but native UTMOSv2 still selects internal SSL/spec crops within each window.
The final shorter remainder is tiled by the native SSL dataset to its 3 s input duration.
Duration-weighted means are a custom descriptive aggregation and are not validated whole-file MOS.
UTMOSv2 predicted MOS is a naturalness proxy without human labels for this corpus; no speech-quality acceptance claim is made.
This run does not include IQ3 and does not rerun the earlier random-window 16-case protocol.
